_how_to: One entry per thread. Use the thread ID prefix from 'generate.py --list'.
must_mention: facts a correct result MUST contain (amounts, names, key terms), checked case- and accent-insensitively.
must_not_mention: things that would be wrong (invented names, wrong amounts, admin noise).
expect_deal_update: true if at least one email in the thread is a real deal update.
expect_open_steps: number of actions still open after the last email (omit if unsure).
Entries whose thread starts with REPLACE are ignored. Aim for 10-15 varied threads.
